name: Shape Waves
description: WebGPU grid of tiny squares, circles and triangles that ripple with drifting noise, light up and splash under the pointer, with optional text cut-out, glow and a radial intro.
contents: Root div filling its parent with a background color
Single canvas rendered with WebGPU through vgpu: shape grid, blurred glow pass and composite
behavior: Noise field drifts over time and picks the shape and size of each grid cell
Pointer movement anywhere on the window sends ripples through nearby cells and tints them with the hover color
Optional text is cut out of the grid as an empty mask in the center
Radial intro reveals cells from the center outward, replayed when introKey changes
Edges fade toward the background color
Animation stops when offscreen, tab hidden, paused, speed is 0 or reduced motion is on
Canvas fades in once ready; on GPU failure it stays hidden and onError is called
editableByProps: Shape style, cell size, dot size and shape colors
Hover color, background color and glow strength
Noise scale, speed, contrast, brightness, flow and direction
Edge fade, pointer interaction, splash radius and strength
Intro on/off, duration and replay through introKey
Optional centered text with font family, weight and size

needsCodeEdit.change: Change ripple physics (wave speed, friction, decay)
needsCodeEdit.where: WAVE_SPEED, WAVE_FRICTION and WAVE_DECAY constants at the top of the file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change intro look (band width, warp, jitter)

fixed: Requires the vgpu package and a browser with WebGPU; without it the canvas stays invisible and only the background color shows
Client component, rendered only in the browser
Fills its parent, so the parent needs a defined width and height
Root is pointer-events-none and aria-hidden, so it is purely decorative and cannot receive clicks
Listens to pointermove and scroll on the window while mounted, so hover works even when content sits above it
Colors accept only hex strings (3 or 6 digits), others fall back to defaults
cellSize minimum is 2, scale minimum is 0.05, introDuration minimum is 0.1
Pixel ratio capped at 2 and text mask capped at 1024px
Noise detail uses only 2 octaves and three size levels, fixed in the shader
Default font is Geist, which must be loaded by the page for text to use it

options.look: Squares, circles and triangles mixed across the field by noise level, all at the same size
options.useWhen: You want the full varied tech look

options.look: Only squares whose size varies with noise level
options.useWhen: You want a pixel or grid feel

options.look: Only circles whose size varies with noise level
options.useWhen: You want a soft halftone dot look

options.look: Only triangles whose size varies with noise level
options.useWhen: You want a sharp, directional look
